label: ESP-IDF: Fullclean (Docker)
command: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/project -w /project -u $UID -e HOME=/tmp -e IDF_GIT_SAFE_DIR=/project espressif/idf:v5.3 idf.py -B build/idf fullclean

label: ESP-IDF: Build (Docker)
command: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/project -w /project -u $UID -e HOME=/tmp -e IDF_GIT_SAFE_DIR=/project espressif/idf:v5.3 bash -lc 'rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old && idf.py -B build/idf -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=sdkconfig.defaults fullclean set-target esp32c6 reconfigure build'

label: ESP-IDF: Flash (Docker, /dev/ttyACM0)
command: PORT=$(readlink -f /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Espressif_USB_JTAG_serial_debug_unit_* 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then PORT=/dev/ttyACM0; fi; [ -e "$PORT" ] || { echo "No ESP serial port found (checked by-id and /dev/ttyACM0)"; exit 1; }; TTY_GID=$(stat -c %g "$PORT"); docker run --rm -v $PWD:/project -w /project -u $UID -e HOME=/tmp -e IDF_GIT_SAFE_DIR=/project --device="$PORT" --group-add $TTY_GID espressif/idf:v5.3 bash -lc 'rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old && idf.py -B build/idf -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=sdkconfig.defaults -p '"$PORT"' -b 115200 fullclean set-target esp32c6 reconfigure flash'

label: ESP-IDF: Monitor (Docker, /dev/ttyACM0)
command: PORT=$(readlink -f /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Espressif_USB_JTAG_serial_debug_unit_* 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then PORT=/dev/ttyACM0; fi; [ -e "$PORT" ] || { echo "No ESP serial port found (checked by-id and /dev/ttyACM0)"; exit 1; }; TTY_GID=$(stat -c %g "$PORT"); docker run --rm -it -v $PWD:/project -w /project -u $UID -e HOME=/tmp -e IDF_GIT_SAFE_DIR=/project --device="$PORT" --group-add $TTY_GID espressif/idf:v5.3 idf.py -B build/idf -p "$PORT" -b 115200 monitor

label: ESP-Zigbee: Build OTA File
command: docker image inspect zigbeetle-ota:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Missing image zigbeetle-ota:latest. Run task: ESP-Zigbee: Build OTA Tool Image (Docker)"; exit 1; }; set -e; VERSION_FILE=${VERSION_FILE:-ota_version.txt}; [ -f "$VERSION_FILE" ] || echo "0x00000002" > "$VERSION_FILE"; VERSION=${VERSION:-$(cat "$VERSION_FILE")}; MANUF_ID=${MANUF_ID:-0x131B}; IMAGE_TYPE=${IMAGE_TYPE:-0xFFBF}; STACK_VER=${STACK_VER:-0x0002}; BIN=${BIN:-build/idf/zigbeetle_c6_sensor.bin}; OUT=${OUT:-build/ota/zigbeetle_${VERSION}.ota}; docker run --rm -v $PWD:/project -w /project -u $UID -e HOME=/tmp -e VERSION="$VERSION" -e MANUF_ID="$MANUF_ID" -e IMAGE_TYPE="$IMAGE_TYPE" -e STACK_VER="$STACK_VER" -e BIN="$BIN" -e OUT="$OUT" zigbeetle-ota:latest bash -lc 'set -e; mkdir -p build/ota; [ -f "$BIN" ] || { echo "Firmware bin not found: $BIN"; exit 1; }; python3 "$ESP_ZB_SDK_PATH"/tools/image_builder_tool/image_builder_tool.py -c "$OUT" -v "$VERSION" -m "$MANUF_ID" -i "$IMAGE_TYPE" -s "$STACK_VER" -f "$BIN"; echo "Created OTA file: $OUT"'; NEXT=$(printf '0x%08x' $((VERSION + 1))); echo "$NEXT" > "$VERSION_FILE"; echo "Next OTA version: $NEXT"
